title: guardian_add
description: Formal spec §7.2 (REQ-7.2-3/4/5/11). Adds exactly one new guardian, named in incoming.

incoming.description: The DID being added as a guardian. REQ-7.2-11: MUST NOT be the ward's own identity.

sigs.description: REQ-7.2-4 (non-empty guardian set): incoming's own key plus enough current guardians to meet addition_threshold. REQ-7.2-5 (empty set): incoming's own key plus the ward's own current operational key.
